effects.does: Opens the Clara assistant panel.
effects.affects: It displays the available Clara summary for the current project without changing event data.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify that the Clara panel opens.

effects.does: Opens a control for attaching files to the event.
effects.affects: It adds selected attachments to the event or its terms configuration.
effects.check: Click Add Attachments and verify that an attachment control opens.

effects.does: Opens the terms and conditions editor.
effects.affects: It allows the event terms and conditions, including their attachments, to be changed.
effects.check: Click Add T&Cs and verify that the terms editor opens.

effects.does: Opens the line-item manager showing two items.
effects.affects: It allows the event's line items to be added, edited, or deleted.
effects.check: Click Items 2 and verify that the line-item drawer opens with two items.

effects.does: Saves the current event as a draft.
effects.affects: It creates or updates the draft event and persists its title, line items, participants, and stage data.
effects.check: Click Save as draft and verify that the event is saved with draft status.

effects.does: Validates and publishes the event.
effects.affects: It moves the event from creation into its published or project-publishing flow and blocks publication when required data is missing.
effects.leadsTo: Publish confirmation dialog or published event state
effects.check: Click Publish and verify that validation runs before publication.

effects.does: Selects RFQ as the event mode.
effects.affects: It changes the stage mode and can reset existing event data when switching from another mode.
effects.leadsTo: RFQ configuration on the same screen
effects.check: Switch to RFQ and verify the RFQ mode is selected and any reset warning appears when applicable.

effects.does: Opens the buy-template selector.
effects.affects: Selecting a template changes the event schema and can reset existing template-dependent data.
effects.check: Click Buy Template and verify that available buy templates are displayed.

effects.does: Opens the column-selection control.
effects.affects: It changes which line-item columns are displayed or configured in the event.
effects.check: Click Add Columns and verify that selectable columns are shown.

effects.does: Opens the event details configuration.
effects.affects: It allows event-level details such as the title or description to be viewed or edited.
effects.check: Click Details and verify that event detail fields are displayed.

effects.does: Opens the price-components configuration.
effects.affects: It allows the price structure or price components used for line-item bids to be configured.
effects.check: Click Price Components and verify that price-component settings are displayed.

effects.does: Opens participant management.
effects.affects: It allows vendors or other event participants to be added or removed from the audience.
effects.check: Click Participants and verify that the participant list and add control appear.

effects.does: Opens the savings configuration or summary.
effects.affects: It allows savings information associated with the event to be viewed or changed.
effects.check: Scroll to Savings, click it, and verify that savings content opens.

effects.does: Opens the terms and conditions section.
effects.affects: It allows the event's terms and conditions and related clauses or attachments to be edited.
effects.leadsTo: Terms and conditions drawer or section
effects.check: Scroll to Terms & Conditions, click it, and verify that the terms editor opens.

effects.does: Opens the event schedule control showing the current start time and duration.
effects.affects: It changes the stage start, end, or duration configuration used during publication.
effects.check: Click the displayed schedule and verify that start and end-time controls appear.

effects.does: Selects the Technical Stage tab.
effects.affects: It changes the currently displayed stage without changing event data.
effects.check: Click Technical Stage and verify that its configuration is displayed.

effects.does: Selects the RFQ stage tab.
effects.affects: It changes the currently displayed stage without changing event data.
effects.check: Verify that RFQ is marked selected and its fields are visible.

effects.does: Navigates back to the events list.
effects.affects: Nothing in the current event data.
effects.check: Click Events and verify that the events list loads.

effects.control: Enter the title of the project
effects.does: Accepts the project title entered by the buyer.
effects.affects: It changes the event or project title used in draft saves, publishing, and later event identification.
effects.check: Enter a title and verify that the value remains in the field and is used by save or publish.

effects.control: Search vendors you want to add
effects.does: Searches for and adds vendors to the event audience.
effects.affects: It changes the event participant or audience records used for invitations and publication validation.
effects.check: Search for a vendor, select it, and verify that the vendor appears in the participant list.

effects.does: Sets the product for a line item.
effects.affects: It changes the line item's product record and the product data sent when the event is saved.
effects.check: Select a product and verify that the Product cell is populated.

effects.does: Sets the product variant for a line item.
effects.affects: It changes the line item's product-quality or variant record used in the event payload.
effects.check: Select a variant and verify that the Product Variant cell is populated.

effects.does: Accepts the quantity requested for a line item.
effects.affects: It changes the line-item requested quantity used for vendor bidding and saved event data.
effects.check: Enter a valid quantity and verify that it is retained and validated as required.

effects.does: Sets the delivery location for a line item.
effects.affects: It changes the line item's delivery-location value used in the RFQ.
effects.check: Enter or select a delivery location and verify that the cell is populated.

effects.does: Accepts the requested or bid price for a line item.
effects.affects: It changes the line-item price used in amount calculations and vendor comparison.
effects.check: Enter a price and verify that it is accepted with the configured currency.

effects.does: Accepts the quantity available for a line item.
effects.affects: It changes the available-quantity value stored for the line item.
effects.check: Enter a quantity available and verify that the value is retained.

effects.does: Accepts the GST value or configuration for a line item.
effects.affects: It changes the tax information used when calculating the line-item total.
effects.check: Enter or select GST and verify that the tax value is displayed for the line item.

effects.does: Displays or calculates the line item's total amount.
effects.affects: It changes or reflects the calculated monetary total used for event comparison and saving.
effects.check: Change the price, quantity, or GST and verify that Total Amount updates accordingly.

Each draft stage → `GET /v1/trade/:id/schema?response_type=template&additional_fields=order_details&l1_prices=true` (plus `&rfq_to_auction=true` when converting), then `GET /companies/audience_for_product?trade_request_uuid=<id>` — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1143-1165, src/models/

Publish never stores the returned stage uuids (only Save as draft does), so a retry after a failed project PATCH (e.g. 712) POSTs every stage again — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1826-1839 vs 1516-1536

Title "Are you sure you want to award this vendor?", field "Quantity Offered *" pre-filled with the vendor's `participant_quantity` and unit suffix; info "TR is pending for this line item." when unscored — src/components/dataGrid/formatters/comparisonSelectionFormatter.jsx:29-74

Saving the strategy drawer in project creation resets the stage title to the auto title computed with no other stages (`allModes: []`), overwriting a renamed title and its number — src/views/eventCreation/components/auctionConfiguration/auctionConfiguration.jsx:497-506

First save → `POST /event_groups` `{status:"draft", title, line_items:[{product_uuid, quantity:{unitSymbol,value}, product_quality_uuid, serial_number, pr_line_item_uuid, pr_id}]}`; later saves → `PATCH /event_groups/:id` — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:2259-2269, src/redux/project/a

Drawer disabled when fromPR, `isEditingAllowed=false` or `isAddNewStage`; variant shows "Variant of product cannot be modified", quantity/unit " 'Quantity Requested' and 'Unit of Measurement' cannot be modified" (quantity still editable when fromPR) — src/views/projectCreation/components/projectLine

Shown only when not RFQ→Auction, `allow_draft_project_creation` on, not (service-RFP grouping AND `groupServiceActivitiesInRfp`), auctions not routed to the auction team, and the current stage is not recurring — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:292-296, 3343-3345
Disabled with tooltip "Please select template for <stage title>" for any non-RFP stage without a template, or "Please add line items" — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1457-1481

choosing "Custom duration" first sets end to undefined; closing the popover then Save passes (NaN comparisons) and publish fails "Please add end time for the event" — stageSchedulerCard.jsx:302-314. Backend has no end>start / end>now check (trade-stages.md part 8): candidate API test with past `bid_

Changing an existing template asks "Do you really want to change the template?" (project) / "Changing template will reset data. Are you sure?" (quick-create), OK "Yes" — templateSelection.jsx:349-360, src/translations/en.json eventCreation.handleTemplateDataReset
In project creation `product`, `creator_quantity`, `variant` are locked; PR events also lock READ_ONLY_WIDGETS_IN_PR_TO_AUCTION and `blockEditFromPr` widgets — templateSelection.jsx:248-272

AI RFP → `POST /ask_ai_chats/rfp_questions`, then `GET /external_requests/:uuid`; the AI button needs project line items — src/views/eventCreation/components/aiRfpGenerator/api.js:3-11, src/views/eventCreation/eventCreation.jsx:1854-1876

Project title input is disabled when adding a new stage to an existing project — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1433-1435, 3283-3292
